runtime: tools/build_manila_stream_shards.py merges buildings.geojson, building-footprints.geojson and building-details.geojson. Populated buildings.geojson geometry has priority; footprints fill missing geometry; details enrich matching IDs and add unmatched building/building-part polygons and mapped building nodes. OpenMapTiles PBF is used for roads and non-building POIs; transportation.geojson supplies street geometry and names.

photo_facade_textures.status: No human-verified building/photo matches are currently available; no candidate photo may be assigned automatically.

building_source.runtime_role: combined geometry and attribute source; geometry priority is buildings.geojson, then building-footprints.geojson, with building-details.geojson enriching by source ID and adding unmatched buildings/parts

street_source.runtime_role: always imported for named street-label geometry; labels overlay PBF road surfaces without replacing them
